offerings.name: Reader API (s.jina.ai) — Search the web and convert results to LLM-friendly text
offerings.pricing: API pricing is based on the token usage. Every request costs a fixed number of tokens, starting from 10,000 tokens. Prototype Development: $50 / 0.050 per 1M tokens; Production Deployment: $500 / 0.045 per 1M tokens
offerings.price_basis: Standard key $0.050/1M tokens，每次搜索最低固定消耗 10,000 tokens 机械换算 ≈ $0.50/1k；Premium key $0.045/1M tokens 则约 $0.45/1k
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens (Toy Experiment, non-commercial use only, CC-BY-NC)
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果（top five results with their URLs and contents, LLM-friendly text）
offerings.note: 返回 top 5 结果，含 URL 与内容；Premium 档 1000 RPM，免费档 100 RPM；平均延迟 2.5s；新旧定价（2025-05-06 起新模型）以购买时间为准
